_doc: TC-PIN (decision 0004 item 3, decision 0017). Hash pins for the OPTIONAL theorycraft calc component: an unmodified Path of Building PoE2 source archive and a LuaJIT source archive, fetched by scripts/setup.ps1 (tools/tc_pin.py) into the AL sidecar only when the user opts in (setup.ps1 -TcCalc or config/local.json "tc_calc": true). Every value was read from the public GitHub API / archives on the verified date; the archive sha256 was computed from two independent downloads. A missing or malformed value makes setup refuse; never guess one. The pin moves only by a commit with the bridge tests green. No absolute paths here.
